prompts.task_zh: 用英文写一段自我介绍：你的名字、年龄或工作、住在哪里、喜欢做什么。
prompts.task_en: Write about yourself: your name, your job or age, where you live and what you like doing.
checklist_zh: 每句话都有主语和动词
用到 I am / I like / I live in

prompts.task_zh: 写写你通常怎么过周末：几点起床、和谁在一起、做什么。
prompts.task_en: Write about a normal weekend for you: when you get up, who you are with and what you do.
checklist_zh: 用一般现在时说习惯（I get up…）

prompts.title_zh: 句子改写：there is / there are
prompts.title_en: Rewrite with there is / there are
prompts.task_zh:
把下面三句话改写成用 there is / there are 开头的句子，然后再写两句描述你的房间：
1. My room has a big window.
2. Our street has two cafés.
3. The fridge has some milk.
prompts.task_en: Rewrite the three sentences with there is / there are, then add two sentences about your room.
checklist_zh: 单数用 there is，复数用 there are
加了两句描述自己房间的句子

prompts.title_zh: 给朋友发消息：周六一起吃饭
prompts.task_zh: 给朋友写一条短消息，约他 / 她周六一起吃饭：说清楚时间、地点，再问对方能不能来。
prompts.task_en: Write a short message inviting a friend to dinner on Saturday. Say when and where, and ask if they can come.
checklist_zh: 写清楚时间和地点（at / on / in）

prompts.task_zh: 写写你上一次假期：去了哪里、和谁一起、做了什么、感觉怎么样。
prompts.task_en: Write about your last holiday: where you went, who with, what you did and how it was.
checklist_zh: 用一般过去时（went / saw / ate）
用 and / but / because 连句子

prompts.task_zh: 你下周二不能去上课。给老师写一封邮件：说明原因，问问怎么补上这节课的内容。
prompts.task_en: You can't come to class next Tuesday. Email your teacher: explain why and ask how to catch up.

prompts.title_zh: 观点：孩子应该有手机吗？
prompts.task_zh: 你觉得小学生应该有自己的手机吗？说出你的观点和两个理由。
prompts.task_en: Should primary school children have their own phones? Give your opinion and two reasons.
checklist_zh: 第一句就说清楚观点（I think …）
用 First / Also 列出两个理由

prompts.task_zh: 读完阅读室的《A Rainy Saturday》，用 3–5 句话写一个摘要：发生了什么、他们做了什么、结果怎样。尽量用自己的话。
prompts.task_en: After reading 'A Rainy Saturday', write a 3–5 sentence summary in your own words.
checklist_zh: 只写主要情节，不抄原句

prompts.title_zh: 观点：线上学习和线下课堂
prompts.task_zh: 比较线上学习和线下课堂，说说各自的优点，以及你更喜欢哪一种、为什么。
prompts.task_en: Compare online learning with classroom learning. Give the advantages of each and say which you prefer and why.
checklist_zh: 有开头、主体、结尾三部分
用 However / On the other hand 表示对比

prompts.title_zh: 投诉邮件：买到的耳机坏了
prompts.task_zh: 你在网上买的耳机用了一周就坏了。给商家写一封投诉邮件：说明问题，提出你希望的解决办法。
prompts.task_en: The headphones you bought online broke after a week. Write a complaint email explaining the problem and what you want them to do.
checklist_zh: 说清楚购买时间、问题细节
提出具体要求（退款 / 换货）
